arc.en.arc1.title: Dasar-dasar
cando.en.a0.u01.sounds: Bisa ngrungokake lan niru bedane swara vokal lan konsonan dhasar ing basa Inggris.
cando.en.a0.u02.basics: Bisa nggunakake sawetara frasa pitulungan: salam, matur nuwun, lan njaluk wong liya supaya alon-alon.
cando.en.a0.u02.numbers: Bisa ngucapake lan ngerteni angka siji nganti sepuluh.
cando.en.a1.u01.greet: Bisa menehi salam marang wong liya, nanggepi salam, lan pamitan kanthi sopan.
cando.en.a1.u01.intro-self: Bisa nyebutake jenenge lan ngenalake awake dhewe kanthi ukara sing prasaja.
cando.en.a1.u02.langs: Bisa nyebutake basa apa wae sing dikuasai.
cando.en.a1.u02.origin: Bisa nyebutake asale saka negara ngendi lan takon marang wong liya babagan sing padha.
cando.en.a1.u03.family: Bisa nyebutake anggota kulawarga cedhak lan ngandhakake babagan dheweke kanthi prasaja.
cando.en.a1.u04.count: Bisa ngitung, nyebutake rega lan umur, lan ngerteni angka nalika krungu.
cando.en.a1.u05.clock: Bisa takon lan menehi katrangan wektu kanthi prasaja.
cando.en.a1.u05.dates: Bisa nyebutake dina, tanggal, lan kapan kedadeyan sawijining bab.
cando.en.a1.u06.likes: Bisa nyebutake panganan lan ombenan apa sing disenengi lan dikarepake.
cando.en.a1.u07.order: Bisa pesen panganan lan ombenan kanthi sopan lan njaluk tagihan.
cando.en.a1.u08.around-town: Bisa nyebutake apa wae sing ana ing kutha lan panggonane barang-barang.
cando.en.a1.u09.routine: Bisa njlentrehake pakaryan saben dinane lan sepira kerepe nindakake sawijining bab.
cando.en.a1.u10.jobs: Bisa nyebutake pakaryane lan takon marang wong liya babagan pakaryane.
cando.en.a1.u11.possessions: Bisa nyebutake apa sing diduweni lan takon apa sing diduweni wong liya.
cando.en.a1.u12.describe-things: Bisa nyebutake warna lan sandhangan sarta njlentrehake wujud barang-barang.
cando.en.a1.u13.ability: Bisa nyebutake apa sing bisa lan ora bisa ditindakake sarta nggawe panjaluk sing prasaja.
cando.en.a1.u14.now: Bisa njlentrehake apa sing kedadeyan ing saubenge ing wektu iki.
cando.en.a1.u15.weather: Bisa ngrembug babagan cuaca lan mangsa kanthi prasaja.
cando.en.a1.u16.transport: Bisa tuku karcis, ngetutake pituduh sing prasaja, lan nggunakake transportasi umum.
cando.en.a1.u17.prices: Bisa takon regane barang lan nangani tuku-tuku sing prasaja.
cando.en.a1.u18.describe-people: Bisa njlentrehake wujud lan sipate wong liya.
cando.en.a1.u19.hobbies: Bisa ngrembug babagan hobi lan kegiatan wektu luang sing disenengi.
cando.en.a1.u20.past: Bisa nyebutake ana ing ngendi lan apa sing ditindakake ing ukara past tense sing prasaja.
cando.en.a1.u21.tell-past: Bisa nyritakake crita cekak babagan minggu kepungkur nggunakake kriya past tense sing umum.
cando.en.a1.u22.plans: Bisa ngrembug babagan rencana lan ngajak wong liya nindakake samubarang bebarengan.
cando.en.a1.u23.feelings: Bisa nyebutake perasaane lan njlentrehake masalah kesehatan sing prasaja.
cando.en.a1.u24.home: Bisa njlentrehake omahe sarta kamar lan barang-barang sing ana ing njero.
cando.en.a1.u25.compare: Bisa mbandhingake wong, panggonan, lan barang ing ukara sing prasaja.
cando.en.a1.u26.connect: Bisa nggabungake gagasan prasaja kanthi 'and', 'but', lan 'because'.
cando.en.a1.u27.about-me: Bisa menehi pambuka lisan cekak: sapa dheweke, apa pakaryane, lan apa sing disenengi.
cando.en.a1.u28.show: Bisa nggabungake kabeh materi ing siji sesi review.
gn.en.gn.adv-freq.note: Tembung-tembung kaya 'usually', 'often', lan 'sometimes' nuduhake sepira kerepe sawijining pakulinan. Tembung-tembung iki manggon sadurunge kriya utama lan sawise 'be': "I usually walk. She is often late."
gn.en.gn.adv-freq.title: Kata keterangan frekuensi
gn.en.gn.art-the.note: 'The' tegese sing wis padha dingerteni: "the station", "the sun", utawa sebutan kaping pindho. Jamak umum ora nggunakake 'the': "I like dogs."
gn.en.gn.art-the.title: the (dhasar)
gn.en.gn.articles-a-an.note: Gunakake 'a' sadurunge swara konsonan lan 'an' sadurunge swara vokal: a book, an apple, an hour. Iki nuduhake siji barang sing ora spesifik.
gn.en.gn.articles-a-an.title: a / an
gn.en.gn.be-1sg-2sg.note: 'Am' digunakake karo 'I', lan 'are' digunakake karo 'you': "I am Anna. You are my friend." Rong wujud iki digunakake kanggo pambuka pisanan.
gn.en.gn.be-1sg-2sg.title: be: I am / you are
gn.en.gn.be-all.note: 'Am', 'is', lan 'are' kanggo kabeh subjek: 'he', 'she', lan 'it' nggunakake 'is'; 'we', 'you', lan 'they' nggunakake 'are'. "She is a doctor. They are from Peru."
gn.en.gn.be-all.title: be: wujud present lengkap
gn.en.gn.be-neg.note: Tambahake 'not' sawise 'be': "I am not tired. She isn't here." Wujud cekak 'isn't' lan 'aren't' luwih lumrah ing pacelathon.
gn.en.gn.be-neg.title: be: ukara negatif
gn.en.gn.be-yesno-q.note: Walik 'be' menyang ngarep: "You are tired." dadi "Are you tired?" Urutan tembung wae wis nggawe dadi pitakonan — ora perlu tembung tambahan.
gn.en.gn.be-yesno-q.title: Pitakonan Yes/No karo be
gn.en.gn.can-ability.note: "I can swim. He can't drive." Siji wujud kanggo saben subjek, lan kriya sawise 'can' tetep wujud dhasar.
gn.en.gn.can-ability.title: can / can't (kemampuan)
gn.en.gn.can-request.note: "Can I have the menu? Can you help me?" — panjaluk sopan saben dina, kanggo ijin lan pitulungan.
gn.en.gn.can-request.title: can (panjaluk)
gn.en.gn.comp-superl.note: Adjektiva cekak nggunakake -er lan -est (older, the oldest); sing dawa nggunakake 'more' lan 'most'. 'Good' dadi 'better' lan 'best'. Bandhingake karo 'than': "My city is bigger than yours."
gn.en.gn.comp-superl.title: Komparatif & Superlatif
gn.en.gn.conn-basic.note: Gabungake gagasan: "I like tea and coffee. It's small but nice. I stayed home because I was tired."
gn.en.gn.conn-basic.title: and / but / because
gn.en.gn.dem-sg.note: 'This' nuduhake barang sing cedhak karo sampeyan lan 'that' nuduhake barang sing luwih adoh: "This is my phone. That is your bag."
gn.en.gn.dem-sg.title: this / that
gn.en.gn.do-neg.note: "I don't know. She doesn't eat meat." 'Don't' utawa 'doesn't' ditambah kriya dhasar — akhiran -s pindhah menyang 'does' lan ninggalake kriya.
gn.en.gn.do-neg.title: Ukara negatif karo don't/doesn't
gn.en.gn.do-quest.note: "Do you like tea? Does she work here?" 'Do' utawa 'does' miwiti pitakonan lan kriya utama tetep ing wujud dhasar.
gn.en.gn.do-quest.title: Pitakonan karo do/does
gn.en.gn.dummy-it.note: Basa Inggris mbutuhake subjek sanajan kanggo cuaca lan wektu: "It is raining. It's cold. It's late." Tembung 'it' ora nuduhake apa-apa — mung ngisi posisi subjek.
gn.en.gn.dummy-it.title: it kanggo cuaca & wektu
gn.en.gn.going-to.note: 'Be' ditambah 'going to' ditambah kriya kanggo rencana: "I'm going to visit my aunt tomorrow. We're going to travel in June."
gn.en.gn.going-to.title: going to (rencana)
gn.en.gn.have-got.note: Kepemilikan: "I have two brothers. She has a car." Sampeyan uga bisa krungu 'have got' — anggep tegese padha.
gn.en.gn.have-got.title: have / has
gn.en.gn.how-much-many.note: 'How many' kanggo barang sing bisa diitung ("How many apples?") lan 'how much' kanggo barang sing ora bisa diitung ("How much water?"). Rega nggunakake "How much is it?"
gn.en.gn.how-much-many.title: How much / How many
gn.en.gn.imperatives.note: Kandhani wong liya apa sing kudu ditindakake kanthi kriya dhasar: "Turn left. Wait here. Please don't stop." Nambahake 'please' nggawe luwih sopan.
gn.en.gn.imperatives.title: Ukara prentah
gn.en.gn.like-want-noun.note: Kriya ditambah barang, ora ana tembung ing antarane: "I like coffee. I want water." Wong sing seneng iku subjek.
gn.en.gn.like-want-noun.title: like / want + kata benda
gn.en.gn.numbers-1-100.note: Ngitung nganti satus lan waspadai jebakan -teen lawan -ty: 'thirteen' lan 'thirty' swarane meh padha, dadi penekanan sing mbedakake.
gn.en.gn.numbers-1-100.title: Angka 1–100
gn.en.gn.obj-pron.note: Me, you, him, her, it, us, them — tembung-tembung iki teka sawise kriya: "Call me. I see her. Ask him."
gn.en.gn.obj-pron.title: Pronomina Objek
gn.en.gn.past-be.note: Wujud past saka 'be': 'I', 'he', 'she', lan 'it' nggunakake 'was'; 'you', 'we', lan 'they' nggunakake 'were'. "I was at home. They were happy."
gn.en.gn.past-be.title: was / were
gn.en.gn.past-irreg-top25.note: Kriya sing paling umum owah wujude ing past tense: 'go' dadi 'went', 'have' dadi 'had', 'see' dadi 'saw', 'do' dadi 'did', 'get' dadi 'got', 'make' dadi 'made'.
gn.en.gn.past-irreg-top25.title: Past tense ora teratur (kriya utama)
gn.en.gn.past-quest-neg.note: "Did you see it? I didn't go." 'Did' nggawa teges past, dadi kriya utama bali menyang wujud dhasar.
gn.en.gn.past-quest-neg.title: did: pitakonan & negatif
gn.en.gn.past-reg.note: Tambahake -ed kanggo tumindak sing wis rampung: "I worked. She visited her mother." Wujud sing padha digunakake kanggo saben subjek.
gn.en.gn.past-reg.title: Past simple: -ed
gn.en.gn.plural-irreg.note: Sawetara kata benda owah tinimbang nambah -s: 'man' dadi 'men', 'woman' dadi 'women', 'child' dadi 'children', 'person' dadi 'people', 'foot' dadi 'feet'.
gn.en.gn.plural-irreg.title: Jamak ora teratur
gn.en.gn.plural-reg.note: Tambahake -s kanggo luwih saka siji, utawa -es sawise s, sh, ch, lan x: one cat, two cats; one box, two boxes.
gn.en.gn.plural-reg.title: Jamak teratur
gn.en.gn.poss-adj.note: My, your, his, her, its, our, their — lebokake sadurunge kata benda: "her book", "our house", "their names".
gn.en.gn.poss-adj.title: Adjektiva posesif
gn.en.gn.poss-s.note: Tambahake 's marang sing duwe: "Anna's dog", "my brother's car". Basa Inggris nyelehake sing duwe dhisik lan barang sing diduweni kapindho.
gn.en.gn.poss-s.title: Posesif 's
gn.en.gn.prep-place.note: In, on, under, next to, behind, in front of, between — tembung-tembung cilik sing nuduhake panggonan: "The keys are on the table."
gn.en.gn.prep-place.title: Preposisi panggonan
gn.en.gn.pres-cont.note: 'Be' ditambah kriya-ing kanggo saiki: "I am eating. They are working. Look, it is raining."
gn.en.gn.pres-cont.title: Present continuous
gn.en.gn.pres-simple-3sg.note: Kanthi 'he', 'she', lan 'it', kriya nggunakake -s: "She works. He watches." Iki minangka huruf sing paling asring dilalekake ing basa Inggris, dadi kudu luwih digatekake.
gn.en.gn.pres-simple-3sg.title: Orang ketiga -s
gn.en.gn.pres-simple-base.note: Kanggo pakulinan lan fakta, gunakake kriya dhasar: "I work at home. They live in Lima." Ora ana owah-owahan akhiran kanggo subjek-subjek iki.
gn.en.gn.pres-simple-base.title: Present simple: I / you / we / they
gn.en.gn.pron-subject.note: I, you, he, she, it, we, they. Basa Inggris mbutuhake subjek diucapake kanthi cetha ing meh saben ukara — "am tired" mbutuhake 'I'.
gn.en.gn.pron-subject.title: Pronomina Subjek
gn.en.gn.simple-vs-cont.note: "I drink coffee every day" minangka pakulinan; "I am drinking coffee" minangka kedadeyan ing wektu iki. Tembung-tembung wektu minangka pitunjuk sampeyan.
gn.en.gn.simple-vs-cont.title: Pakulinan utawa saiki?
gn.en.gn.some-any.note: 'Some' ing ukara positif ("I have some money") lan 'any' ing ukara negatif lan pitakonan ("Do you have any money?").
gn.en.gn.some-any.title: some / any
gn.en.gn.sv-order.note: Ukara basa Inggris nggunakake urutan Subjek–Kriya–Objek: "I eat apples." Urutan iki nggawa teges, dadi tetepake pelaku dhisik lan tumindak kapindho.
gn.en.gn.sv-order.title: Urutan tembung dhasar
gn.en.gn.there-is-are.note: Kanggo nyebutake anane sawijining barang: "There is a bank. There are two cafes." Cocokake 'is' utawa 'are' karo cacahing barang sing dimaksud.
gn.en.gn.there-is-are.title: there is / there are
gn.en.gn.time-prep.note: 'At' kanggo wektu jam (at five), 'on' kanggo dina lan tanggal (on Monday), 'in' kanggo sasi, taun, lan bagéan dina (in May, in the morning).
gn.en.gn.time-prep.title: at / on / in kanggo wektu
gn.en.gn.time-telling.note: Miwiti kanthi 'It's': "It's three o'clock. It's half past two. It's seven fifteen." Tembung 'it' tetep ana sanajan ora ana sing disebutake.
gn.en.gn.time-telling.title: Nyebutake wektu
gn.en.gn.wh-quest-be.note: What, where, who, utawa how, banjur 'be', banjur subjek: "Where are you? What is this? Who is that?"
gn.en.gn.wh-quest-be.title: Pitakonan Wh- karo be
gn.en.gn.would-like.note: "I'd like a coffee, please" minangka cara sopan kanggo pesen utawa njaluk sawijining barang — luwih alus tinimbang "I want".
gn.en.gn.would-like.title: I'd like (sopan)
